blocks.text: CORDOVA, Cebu – Benevola de Cebu Foundation Inc. (BDCFI) brought its Lakbay Alalay Program to Cordova on Friday, October 9, providing 20 wheelchairs and 21 quad canes to 41 residents through a partnership with the Municipality of Cordova and its Municipal Health Office. The Cordova activity marks BDCFI’s third local government partnership for Lakbay Alalay, following earlier turnovers in Mandaue City and Cebu City. BDCFI Trustee Aurelia C. Qui, representing the Foundation’s Board of Trustees, together with Executive Director Wilhelm Wade A. Eusores, joined the beneficiaries during the turnover. Also present were Cordova Mayor Cesar E.
